# Texas Instruments Education

> Texas Instruments Education provides graphing calculators, scientific tools, and comprehensive STEM resources for K-12 and higher education, including professional development for educators.

Education.ti.com is the official educational portal for Texas Instruments, offering a complete ecosystem of calculators (graphing, scientific, financial, and basic), lesson plans, coding projects, and teacher training through the T³ professional development program. The site serves educators and students across mathematics, science, computer science, and financial literacy disciplines.

## Key Topics

- TI-84 Plus CE
- TI-Nspire CX II
- Graphing calculators
- STEM education
- Python programming
- TI-Innovator Hub
- Teacher resources
- Professional development
- Calculator comparison
- Classroom tools
- Math education
- Computer science
- Financial literacy
- Exam approval (ACT, SAT, AP, IB)
- TI Connect CE Software

## Products & Calculators

- [TI Products | Calculators and Technology](https://education.ti.com/en/products): Main product catalog for TI calculators and education technology
- [Graphing Calculators](https://education.ti.com/en/products/calculators/graphing-calculators): Graphing calculator product line including TI-84 Plus and TI-Nspire
- [Scientific Calculators](https://education.ti.com/en/products/calculators/scientific-calculators): Scientific calculator product lineup for STEM education
- [Financial Calculators](https://education.ti.com/en/products/calculators/financial): Financial calculator products including BA II Plus series
- [Basic Calculators](https://education.ti.com/en/products/calculators/basic-calculators): Basic calculator product line for school and office use
- [Elementary Calculators](https://education.ti.com/en/products/calculators/elementary-calculators): Elementary calculator products for early math learning

## Educational Resources & Lessons

- [Math Resources | Lessons & Activities](https://education.ti.com/en/resources/math): Math classroom activities and lessons for TI calculators
- [STEM Resources](https://education.ti.com/en/resources/stem): STEM and coding projects with TI-Innovator and calculators
- [Science Resources | Lessons & Devices](https://education.ti.com/en/resources/science): Science lessons, hands-on labs, and data collection resources
- [Computer Science Resources](https://education.ti.com/en/resources/computer-science): Python programming, robotics, and computer science activities
- [Financial Literacy Resources for Teachers](https://education.ti.com/en/resources/financial-literacy): Financial literacy lesson plans and teacher resources

## Professional Development & Training

- [Professional Development | T³](https://education.ti.com/en/t3-professional-development): T³ professional development workshops and teacher training
- [Free Webinars | Live and On-Demand](https://education.ti.com/en/t3-professional-development/for-teachers-and-teams/online-learning): Free live and on-demand webinars for educator professional learning

## Documentation & Downloads

- [Guidebooks | TI Technology Products](https://education.ti.com/en/product-resources/guidebooks): Downloadable guidebooks and manuals for TI products
- [TI Downloads | Software Updates | Guides](https://education.ti.com/en/downloads): Software updates, OS downloads, and guides for TI technology

## Exam Approval & Reference

- [Is Your Calculator Approved for Exams?](https://education.ti.com/en/resources/test-preparation): Exam approval information for ACT, SAT, AP, and IB tests
